payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped generic FrickStore<Model> (@MainActor @Observable) + FrickModel protocol + FrickStoreEventSource seam in Sources/FrickSwift/FrickStore.swift. Subscribes to one object type over the sync socket, keyed in-memory cache, applies snapshot + .objectsDelta upserts (in-place same-id merge) + .objectsRemoved removals, re-sorts/re-emits items on every apply (both RangerCRM correctness fixes centralized), reconnect self-heals. Added FR-144 native parity: FrickSyncSocket decodes Delta.removed -> FrickInboundEvent.objectsRemoved/FrickObjectRemoval. Tests: 74 pass (11 store + 1 socket removed-decode). typecheck exit 0.
